Skip to workspace
STELLAR FORGE

NocoDB source workspace

Capture · review · retain · publish

Opening private workspace…

Retained request

Source workspace controls

Retained work

Complete observations

Every retained observation includes the original table metadata, counts and all response pages. Capture identity and provider order remain fixed.

Recent operations

Capture from a declared connection

This host supplies the read token. Only the selected table metadata and an explicitly requested full capture are read.

Previously inspected tables

Table selection

Stable provider order

Include every native unique identity field. NocoDB keeps native primary keys outside ordinary fields; use record_id for their published identity.

Fields to capture

Choose actual scalar fields, their public aliases, types and null policy. Numeric text preserves the original JSON number token. Derived values must match the explicitly selected scalar type.

A failed observation retains its received files. A new explicit request starts a new observation.

Import an existing complete observation

Choose a portable NocoDB source packet created by this workspace or its packet command. Import verifies its original manifest, response bytes and selected fields without contacting the provider.

Review source columns

Select a retained observation to begin.

The original captured field union is retained exactly. Change aliases, scalar encodings and null handling here; choose a published column subset in the original publisher.

Retain reviewed source version

Saved source versions

Each version retains its exact original capture and reviewed projection. Selection prepares the source for a new publisher plan; existing plans and published editions retain their original source.

Compare saved versions

Publish and operate

The existing retained publisher prepares the public dataset, reviews its actual candidate, and records published editions and buyer delivery. These controls use the original merchant release store.

Open publisher window

Review a published edition for deployment

Use the actual public origin, fixed route and original payment terms. Reviewing and preparing a package does not send a payment or activate a release.

Prepared packages and release operations

Open release window

The original release console compares and activates the exact staged release, runs or restarts the existing merchant, and retains rollback and customer receiving. Selection and the actually running release remain visible there.

Private local operator · Node 24 · Original NocoDB v3 source and Stellar Forge publication engines

STELLAR FORGE

OData workspace

Connect business data, review a query, and deliver retained editions or live services.

Download workspace
Opening the retained workspace…

Restore a complete large workspace

The browser receives workspace files up to 64 MiB. This complete transfer uses the original OData command on this host. Replace FULL_PATH_TO_TRANSFER with the directory containing your saved file.

The command validates the same complete file closure and reopens every original collection before publishing the received workspace.








Sources & queries
Discover the service’s original schema and select the records you need.


Add an OData v4 service




Query selection
Filters
Select declared properties above. The service’s complete entity keys are retained automatically. Its own continuation controls the actual page size.


Saved queries
Selected query URL




Import & review
Each response is retained before the next page is requested. Resume an interrupted import from its saved continuation.






Edition detail






Compare editions
Match complete source entities by their declared keys and inspect property changes.
Select two complete editions from the same entity set.


Dataset exports
Deliver reviewed entities as original JSON, a typed dataset, and an optional configured merchant route.


Every property includes a state column to distinguish a value, null, and a missing property. Decimal and Int64 properties retain their exact text. The original JSON accompanies the dataset.


Field meanings
Preview the selected fields to inspect their original CSDL types, complete keys, and receiving columns.
Original dictionary and source binding


Retained exports




Merchant releases
Use the existing Stellar Forge release store to stage, select, and reopen an OData dataset seller.
Open the existing release store to inspect staged and active releases.
Start the selected seller
Run the existing release launcher in the retained workspace. It keeps the original payment and dataset lifecycle.




Live services
Offer the reviewed source query through the original Stellar Forge seller. Prepare a customer request, receive its response, and continue from the original next page.


Prepare a live service






Route and runtime settings




Prepared services


Open a prepared service to inspect its source, runtime, and customer files.


Prepare a customer handoff
The original buyer configuration binds the exact request, payment offer, intent, and saved response location. A continuation uses the supplier's returned cursor.


Receive a customer response
Received pages retain the original response, exact typed records, cumulative row count, and the next customer request.


Customer handoffs and received pages
Open a prepared service to view its retained customer work.




Complete customer collections
Open a prepared live service




Assemble the original response chain


Choose the received responses for one complete query, in their original order. The first request comes from the saved service query; each following request uses the previous response’s returned cursor. Choose an original buyer handoff when its request is required.



















Reusing a collection ID resumes that exact selection. Use a new ID for another query, source edition, page chain or field selection. The original supplier count and acquisition window remain visible with the collection.






Original collection rows







Original service metadata and responses remain attached to each retained edition.
